name: Matthew Grose
story: The published 2018 New Zealand Esri User Conference programme lists Matthew Grose of the Department of Conservation presenting 'DOC sees the need for speed' on 21 August 2018. This entry documents his contribution to the conference programme; it does not infer other roles or dates.
